exclusions.source_text: Age ≥18 years. Because no dosing or adverse event data are currently available on the use of toripalimab in combination with cisplatin and docetaxel in participants \<18 years of age, children are excluded from this study, but will be eligible for future pediatric trials.
creatinine ≤ 2 x institutional ULN OR glomerular filtration rate (GFR) ≥ 45 mL/min/1.73 m2
exclusions.threshold: creatinine ≤ 2 x ULN or GFR ≥ 45 mL/min/1.73 m2

exclusions.source_text: total bilirubin ≤ 2 institutional upper limit of normal (ULN) AST(SGOT)/ALT(SGPT) ≤ 2 × institutional ULN
exclusions.threshold: bilirubin ≤ 2 x ULN; AST/ALT ≤ 2 x ULN

exclusions.source_text: Presence of a second malignancy that is considered active by the investigator.
Pregnant women are excluded from this study
breastfeeding should be discontinued if the mother is treated with toripalimab
